facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx, GTABase, GameSpot) — keep them off for the whole run.
facts.honesty: Five trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch (PowerPyx): their guides say so instead of inventing one. Check the cited guides again after launch week.
facts.saves: No mission replay and no New Game Plus (Output Lag) — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.

roadmap.goal: Set up a run that cannot be locked out of the platinum.
items: Turn cheats OFF for the whole run — they disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx, GTABase).
Make a manual save at the start of every chapter. There is no mission replay (Output Lag).

Chapter 1, morning after the mission Down to Earth: find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. It may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and it disappears after Chapter 1 (PowerPyx, GTABase).
roadmap.title: Before you start — saves, cheats, the one missable

roadmap.goal: Clear every story trophy while the story is in front of you.
items: Play Chapters 1-4 in order; chapter and mission trophies pop as you finish them.
Finish the final mission for each side character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — and 8 stranger strands.
Keep your chapter-start saves until the credits roll, then keep one save from before the final mission.
roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4

roadmap.goal: Clear the skill-based trophies while the map is fresh.
items: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges; win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
Win 20 different races; complete 250 stunts; finish 50 challenges.
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge; finish one arcade game; bowl a game at Kolt & Associates.
roadmap.title: Open-world sweep — activities and driving

roadmap.goal: Sweep Leonida region by region so nothing is left to chance.
items: WAiNK It at 100 locations; complete 3 Collectible Card sets; discover 100 vehicles.
Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations) — bring your partner, a spot done with both counts twice.
Explore all 52 areas; buy all 8 garages; register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
roadmap.title: The world itself — collectibles and discovery

roadmap.goal: Close the checklist and take the platinum.
items: Rob 5 bank vaults, one armored truck and one jewelry store undetected; rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through contacts; spend $100,000 across all shops.
Work the in-game 100% checklist (Progress menu) until A Long Road pops — then the platinum follows.
roadmap.title: Cleanup — money, robberies, 100%

trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 pop. There is no extra task: work the five phases in order and it arrives last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: A Long Road (100%) is the last big gate

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. The trophy pops when the mission closes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes — do Lucia's balcony meditation first, before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Do the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude)
Keep a manual save from the chapter start

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Both characters become playable here, which opens most of the side list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Try the activities that open up with both characters
Keep a manual save from the chapter start

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Keep a manual save from the chapter start

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Keep a manual save from the chapter start

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, so this is your only way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Keep a manual save before the final mission

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks naturally as you play the story — no special prep.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks naturally as you play the story — no special prep.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks naturally as you play the story — no special prep.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks naturally as you play the story — no special prep.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks naturally as you play the story — no special prep.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks naturally as you play the story — no special prep.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist in the Progress menu. GTABase splits it 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery. Nothing on it is permanently missable — every requirement can be finished in free roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Open Progress and work the checklist section by section
Finish the story plus the optional tasks

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any stunt counts — jumps, drifts, near misses. Chain them during normal driving; ramps and jump spots speed it up.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive aggressively: jumps, drifts, near misses
Use ramps and jump spots to chain stunts
The counter ticks across the whole run

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities menu shows which you have tried — work through the list until all 9 show as done.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each type once: fishing, racing, arcade, shooting range, drone race, bowling, meditation and the rest
Check the menu until all 9 show as tried

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold each challenge one by one; the range tracks medals per challenge, so you can retry the ones you missed.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Retry the ones that came back silver or bronze

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line first, then race it to win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win a race at each one
The race menu shows which locations are still missing a win

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each distinct race only counts once — spread out across the map.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Replays of a race you already won do not add to the count

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him — steady reeling beats fast reeling.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one full game at any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game you find.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's missions in order until his strand ends with this one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's missions in order until his strand ends with this one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's missions in order until his strand ends with this one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore — start each strand you meet and finish it before moving on.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: The map marks strangers you have met

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's missions in order until his strand ends with this one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's missions in order until his strand ends with this one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice. The Chapter 1 balcony session is the one you can miss: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs that session, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: kitchen at Jason's house, follow Lucia to the balcony, Accept
Meditate at the 18 spots (10 locations) — purple icons when you are close
Bring your partner: a spot done with both counts twice
Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Only Jason can do Bret's questline — follow Bret's missions until the unique-animal hunt opens, then take the shot.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take the unique-animal hunt when it opens

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; the collections menu shows which sets are incomplete, so chase the missing cards set by set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up cards as you explore
Check the collections menu for incomplete sets

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Keep WAiNK It active while you explore and the count climbs on its own — sweep each region before moving on.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Keep WAiNK It active while exploring
Sweep region by region to 100 locations

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving and world tasks; the challenges menu tracks your count, so pick the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Clear the easiest 50 across combat, driving and world tasks

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route of 3 shops close together and keep the heat on between them — do not let the stars drop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Rob them in a row, keeping your Wanted Level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan new vehicles — the discovery counter ticks as you find models you have not seen yet.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive and scan vehicles as you explore
The counter ticks per new model discovered
Work through traffic-heavy areas to find the rare ones

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first — a busy shootout works — then trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a busy shootout with 5+ enemies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — head to Vice City International Airport and leave by a route you take yourself, such as a plane you board on your own. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so check the cited guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.note: Unlock method unconfirmed at launch — check the cited guides again after launch week.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport
Method unconfirmed at launch — re-check the cited guides

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — find one in the world, around military areas, and survive the encounter. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so check the cited guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.note: Unlock method unconfirmed at launch — check the cited guides again after launch week.
steps: Find a Rhino tank in the world
Method unconfirmed at launch — re-check the cited guides

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no one spotting you. If you are seen, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault: get in, crack it, and lose the heat before the next one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on its route, grab the cash, and break away clean.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map tracks which areas you have visited; sweep region by region until none is left grey.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open the map and note the unvisited areas
All 52 areas visited pops the trophy

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang — the map marks illegal operations once you discover them.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Discover illegal operations on the map
Rob one for each of the 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so check the cited guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.note: Unlock method unconfirmed at launch — check the cited guides again after launch week.
steps: Order a cocktail with the view
Method unconfirmed at launch — re-check the cited guides

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet — the description is all the game gives. Check the cited guides again after launch week instead of guessing.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make choices as you play — the game tracks a count up to 500, and the trophy pops when the count is reached.

steps: Keep making choices as you play
The game tracks them to a count of 500

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — fail something, then complete it on the next attempt. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so check the cited guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.note: Unlock method unconfirmed at launch — check the cited guides again after launch week.

Method unconfirmed at launch — re-check the cited guides

trophies.note: Unlock method unconfirmed at launch — check the cited guides again after launch week.
steps: Method unconfirmed at launch — re-check the cited guides

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed (KeenGamer), so check the cited guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.note: Unlock method unconfirmed at launch — check the cited guides again after launch week.

Precise method still being confirmed — re-check the cited guides

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills as you earn them — the total accumulates across the whole run.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy gear, clothes and vehicles — spending accumulates across every shop in Leonida.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the property market — check the map for the ones you have not bought yet.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register the vehicles you own or find — any 10 count.
